resources.string: %1$d of %2$d cores stay offline under load (%3$s)

Cores did not come online even with every core busy: hotplug/core_ctl configuration, a thermal limit at boot, or the CPUs failed to start (PSCI/SMP bring-up). Check dmesg for \"CPUn: failed to come online\".
All %1$d cores work (%2$d offline when idle)
Some cores sleep when idle and come back under load: normal with hotplug or core control.
No cpufreq nodes are readable: the cpufreq driver is missing or SELinux blocks sysfs_devices_system_cpu for apps.
scaling_max_freq is below the hardware maximum: a thermal limit, a power HAL profile or an init script caps this cluster.
The frequency did not rise with every core busy (governor %1$s): governor not working, missing clock driver or a hard thermal cap.
A fixed governor is unusual for daily use (battery or performance cost).
/sys/class/thermal has no zones: the TSENS/thermal driver is not probed, so nothing protects the SoC from overheating.
The zones exist but apps cannot read the temperature (SELinux) or the sensors return errors.
Very hot while idle: a stuck sensor, missing thermal mitigation or a core spinning at full speed.
Implausible values from: %1$s (unused or wrongly scaled sensors).
PowerManager gives no thermal status or headroom: there is no thermal HAL. Apps and games cannot adapt to heat.
No GLES context could be created: the vendor EGL/GLES libraries are missing or fail to load (check ro.hardware.egl and logcat for libEGL).
Rendering in software: the GPU driver is not loaded, so the UI will be slow.
%1$d s, frequency at the end %2$s %% of max, peak %3$s °C
The frequency dropped by more than 30 per cent while hot: thermal throttling. Normal on old SoCs, but compare between builds.
Keeps every core busy and records frequency and temperature. A reboot during the test points at power or thermal problems.
Average frequency (% of max) and hottest sensor
The cpufreq driver reports kHz-scale dummy values (emulator or a placeholder driver): frequency checks do not apply.
/sys/class/thermal exists but SELinux hides it from apps on this ROM; temperatures come only from the thermal HAL below.
